entries.summary: Recover from Windows audio initialization failures without aborting game startup.
details: Retry the selected SDL audio backend once, then try DirectSound when no explicit SDL_AUDIODRIVER override is set.
Load the soundpack only after the mixer opens and continue without sound if every bounded attempt fails.
Log the selected backend, playback devices, mixer backend, default device, and obtained format.
known_limits: The recovery remains on the bundled SDL 2 and SDL_mixer stack; Windows hardware-fault injection was not part of validation.
